article.title: Schweppes香港以流動試飲吧配合太古坊分享活動
article.summary: Marketing-Interactive報道，Schweppes在香港以流動試飲吧推廣橙味汽水及佛手柑檸檬汽水，並與太古坊合作舉行分享活動。
highlights: 指定站點設調飲示範，另有商業區街頭試飲。
Taste Talk Thursday邀創意與商界嘉賓分享。
article.why: 飲品團隊可分開設計初次試飲、再次接觸與零售兌換。
article.next_step: 在不同試飲點用獨立兌換碼，比對派發、活動登記及後續到店情況。
article.detail: 據Marketing-Interactive引述品牌代表，Schweppes安排流動試飲吧到文化活動和購物地點，部分場次設調飲示範，另在商業區安排街頭試飲。品牌與太古坊合作的分享系列提供另一個接觸點。評估活動時可把樣品派發、分享活動登記及零售兌換分開計算。
article.title_en: Schweppes Hong Kong pairs a mobile tasting bar with Taikoo Place talks
article.summary_en: Marketing-Interactive reported that Schweppes is promoting Orangeade and Bergamot Lemonade through a mobile tasting bar and a talk series with Taikoo Place.
highlights_en: Selected stops feature mixology demonstrations, alongside street sampling in commercial districts.
Taste Talk Thursday features guests from creative and business fields.
article.why_en: Beverage teams can design distinct steps for first trial, repeat contact and retail redemption.
article.next_step_en: Use different codes by sampling stop to compare distribution, event sign-ups and later store visits.
article.detail_en: Marketing-Interactive cited a brand representative describing mobile sampling at cultural and shopping destinations, with mixology demonstrations at selected stops and additional street sampling in commercial districts. The Taikoo Place talk series provides another touchpoint. Measure samples, sign-ups and retail redemptions separately.
